title: Nested YAML: schema words versus a literal password: must be flagged
summary: YAML where a nested `password:` key holds a synthetic literal value. Covers 3 inputs.
rationale: Nesting hides the connection between a key and its value. A scanner must tell a schema or a reference under a password key apart from a real literal in the same structure.

expectation.rationale: Issue-specific literal/password range; expectations are the project’s masking policy.
